αἰθέρι: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. dat. sg.
αἰσήποιο: Αἴσηπος — the Aesepus, a river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴης: αἶα — land, earth; fem. gen. sg., epic by-form of γαῖα (= Attic γῆς)
αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle, elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ), with ὄφελες + inf.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg., with the speaker: ’I myself’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a third person: ’she herself’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
βέλος: βέλος — missile, shaft, arrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
βαρὺ: βαρύς — heavy, deep; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’heavily’
βασιλῆϊ: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic βασιλεῖ)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἴπεσκεν: εἶπον — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
εἴσατο: εἴδομαι — liken oneself to, take the likeness of; aor. 3 sg. mid., with acc. of respect and dat. of the person
εὐχωλὴν: εὐχωλή — vaunt, boast; a thing to boast of, triumph; fem. acc. sg.
εὔχετο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg.: ’was praying’ (no augment written; εὐ- not lengthened to ηὐ-)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’ · also accented before the enclitic γε: θάνατόν γε ’death at least’
θαλάμῳ: θάλαμος — inner room, bedchamber; masc. dat. sg.
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul, anger; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θώρηκος: θώραξ — breastplate, cuirass; masc. gen. sg., epic θώρηκ- (= Attic θώρακος)
κάλ: καλός — fair, fine, goodly; neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with τεύχεα: ’fine (armour)’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’)
καθ: κατά (elided καθ’) — down, down to; prep. + acc., aspirated before rough breathing (καθ’ ἕδρας ’down to their seats’) · also + acc., ’through, throughout’ (καθ’ ὕλην ’through the wood’)
κατέθηκε: κατατίθημι — put down, set down; aor. 3 sg. act. (κ-aorist): ’set down’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’)
κελαινεφὲς: κελαινεφής — dark with cloud, black-clouded (epithet of Zeus); masc. voc. sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’)
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. 3 sg.: ’lies’
κρατερῷ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; adj., masc. dat. sg.
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κρονίδης: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus (Zeus); masc. nom. sg., patronymic
κὰδ: κατά (κάδ before δ-) — down; preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (κὰδ … λίποιεν = καταλίποιεν ’leave behind’)
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg.
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’, ’having seized’
λαὸς: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λυκάονος: Λυκάων — Lycaon, father of Pandarus; masc. gen. sg. · also Lycaon, a son of Priam and brother of Paris; masc. gen. sg.
μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. nom. pl., epithet of the gods
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. acc. sg., with ὕδωρ
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
μενέλαον: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. acc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be eager, rage; pres. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’eager, furious’
μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
μενελάῳ: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, brother of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg.
μετέφη: μετάφημι — speak among, address a group; aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’
ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἴκαδε: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv., οἶκος + directional suffix -δε
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον)
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’
οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; neut. acc. sg.: ’only, nothing but’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πέλει: πέλω — be, come to be; pres. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐστί): ’is, exists’
πέτρης: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. gen. sg.
παιδὸς: παῖς — child, son; masc. gen. sg.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην … πατρίδα γαῖαν ’dear native land’)
πατρίδος: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. gen. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
πιστὰ: πιστός — trusty, faithful; neut. acc. pl., attributive: ὅρκια πιστά ’faithful oaths’
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πολυδαιδάλου: πολυδαίδαλος — much-wrought, intricately made; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with θώρηκος
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε)
που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριάμῳ: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. dat. sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’
σπονδαί: σπονδή — libation, drink-offering (pl. also a truce or pact sealed by libation); fem. nom. pl.: ’libations’
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg.
σφι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. σφι: ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σύν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat., accented before the enclitic τε that follows
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
σῷ: σός — your (sg.); masc. dat. sg., with πατρί · also with υἱέϊ: ’your (son)’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’)
τροίῃ: Τροίη — Troy; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic Τροίᾳ)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τύμβῳ: τύμβος — burial mound, tomb; masc. dat. sg.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. acc. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized)
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a named man: ’good’ (πὺξ ἀγαθὸν Πολυδεύκεα ’Polydeuces, good with his fists’)
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφότερον: ἀμφότερος — both; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’in both respects’ (ἀμφότερον … τε … τε ’both … and’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργείην: Ἀργεῖος — Argive, of Argos; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic -είην (= Attic Ἀργείαν)
ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
ἀρνῶν: ἀρήν — lamb; gen. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
ἄκρητοι: ἄκρητος — unmixed (of wine); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with σπονδαί
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency; with the subj. = future contingency, ’perhaps, may’ · also with the opt., potential: ’would, could’ (οὐκ ἄν τι φέροις ’you could not carry off anything’) · also ὅτ’ ἄν + subj., ’whenever’ (= ὅταν)
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive land (Greece); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also the Pelasgian Argos, a district of northern Greece; neut. acc. sg.
ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἅλιον: ἅλιος — vain, to no purpose; masc. acc. sg., predicative with πόνον: ’vain’
ἆλτο: ἅλλομαι — leap, spring; aor. 3 sg. mid., athematic, epic (= Attic ἥλατο): ’sprang’
ἐΰξοον: εὔξοος — well-polished, smooth; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐΰξοον
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπέπιθμεν: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust; plpf. 1 pl. ἐπέπιθμεν, epic (+ dat.): ’we trusted’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφεύροι: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general relative clause: ’whom he might find’
ἐχεπευκὲς: ἐχεπευκής — sharp-pointed (the usual explanation; formation uncertain); neut. acc. sg.
ἐϋμμελίω: ἐϋμμελίης — with good ash-spear; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -ω (= Attic -ου)
ἑκατόμβην: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. sg.
ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they cast out’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔργῳ: ἔργον — deed, action; neut. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by deed’
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠρήρειστο: ἐρείδω — press, fix, lodge; plpf. pass. 3 sg., epic reduplicated: ’was driven home’
ἠρήσαντο: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they prayed’
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰὸν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’)
ἱερῆς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
ἱρὴ: ἱρός — holy, sacred; fem. nom. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic ἱερά)
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also after ὄφρα: ’that you may see’
ἴλιος: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. nom. sg.
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., also + gen.: ποδῶν ὑπένερθε ’beneath their feet’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’)
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ᾗς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., agreeing with ὑπεροπλίῃσι · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗς (= ᾗσι, Attic αἷς): ’in which’ (ᾗς ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥίγησεν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’shuddered’
ῥοάων: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
